description: This file contains the PHP class `Api` within the `Opencart"Service". It handles API authentication, session management, and related operations for the OpenCart catalog system.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class responsible for managing API authentication, sessions, and security in the OpenCart catalog system.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates an API user by username and key, returning the user data if successful.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API details based on a session token.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Fetches active sessions for a given API ID.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes API sessions associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the last modified time of a session to keep it alive.

methods.name: cleanSessions
methods.description: Deletes expired API sessions from the database.
